checked.comment: Stochastic K-armed bandit with rewards in [0,1], known horizon T; mapping is correct.
Anytime version of the same setting; the learner does not know T.
Theorem 1: R_T <= (K-1)+23 sqrt(KT), known T, f(T,K)=floor((T/K)^{1/5}).
Theorem 2: pull-count bound (ln T - ln ln T)/Kinf + O_T(1) with the stated condition on T and mu_star in (0,1). Using the remainder symbol R_rem is acceptable.
Theorem 4: anytime pull-count bound ln T/Kinf + O_T((ln T)^{6/7}).
Proposition 7: MOSS bound (K-1)+17 sqrt(KT). The paper re-proves this known result, but the explicit constant comes from its own proof; is_new=false is appropriate.
Proposition 9: MOSS-anytime bound with c=30 for ln_+ (c=33 for the augmented exploration function, noted in the record). Re-proved known result; is_new=false.
